exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.cue: Sit back and down, chest tall, heels flat.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, body in one line. Knees down is fine.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: Step back, lower the back knee, drive up through the front heel.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Squeeze at the top and hold for a second.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Elbows under shoulders, ribs down, keep breathing.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Hold one dumbbell at your chest, elbows inside the knees at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.cue: Lie on the floor, upper arms touch down, press straight up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.cue: Hand on a knee or a chair, pull the bell to your hip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, push the hips back, bells close to your legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Ribs down, press up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Elbows under shoulders, ribs down, keep breathing.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.cue: Bar on your upper back, brace, sit down between your heels.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.cue: Feet down, shoulder blades pinned, touch the lower chest.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Slow on the way back, hips stay down.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.cue: Sit tall, pull to your stomach, squeeze your shoulder blades.
